one_line: Twilio-owned email delivery platform that sends transactional and marketing email at scale via a broad REST API.
auth_notes: API key (starts with SG.) generated in the SendGrid dashboard; sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header on v3 Web API calls. Full account access key or scoped keys (mail.send, stats, etc.).
self_serve_notes: Free tier (100 emails/day, no credit card) that upgrades to paid plans; a dev can sign up solo and generate API keys immediately.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: v3 Web API with ~150+ endpoints covering mail send, templates, marketing campaigns, contacts/lists, stats, IP pools, suppression groups, subusers and more; OpenAPI spec published
api_surface.webhook_note: Event webhook (delivered/opened/clicked/bounced etc.) and Inbound Parse webhook for receiving email

existing_mcp.note: No official Twilio SendGrid MCP server found; community MCP servers for SendGrid exist in registries/GitHub

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms SendGrid v3 Web API is REST for sending email, campaigns, contacts and stats (docs.sendgrid.com); auth/plans/webhooks from platform knowledge

agent_notes: Simple API key auth, free tier available; the fetched page was mostly navigation but the API reference is well documented.
